race.comment: ACTION KING (2) has returned in career-best order for an in-form Rob Potter yard. He just missed the bob first up in Queensland in what's proven a strong form race, then made light work of them back on home turf. He's going too well to ignore, and if Grima can have him no worse than midfield he should blend in sweetly and be right in the finish. MANUKAU (7) flashed home into fourth here when resuming two weeks ago and while the draw means she could be left with plenty to do again, her late strength keeps her firmly in the mix. SEA ADMIRAL (4) mixed his form last prep but his peaks stack up and his lead-up trial suggests he's come back in terrific order. From the inside draw he can play a major role. FUADEE (3) flew down the outside for a barnstorming win first up at Kembla under an apprentice and now gets Hyeronimus. Don't underestimate. RHIA (9) resumes for A & S Freedman and gets JMac off some solid Vic jumpouts. Keep safe.
